title: Tires, spare tire, and repair kit
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on tire preferences, flat-tire handling, and the absence or performance of spare-tire and repair-kit provisions, with many fragments describing requests or situations without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise tire sidewall quality or express satisfaction with run-flat tire functionality.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe dissatisfaction with missing or ineffective emergency tire support, sensor compatibility issues, or dissatisfaction tied to tire-related ownership experience.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews mention a serious problem with the emergency tire repair kit while not providing enough additional detail to separate any offsetting positive aspect.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly describe flat tires, preferences for spare, run-flat, all-season, or winter tire options, and explanatory comments about the mobility kit without a clear evaluative stance.

limitations: Most sampled fragments in this topic are undetermined, which limits confidence in summarizing clear sentiment patterns.
The topic mixes several related but distinct subjects, including tire type preferences, missing spare tires, flat-tire incidents, repair kits, and tire sensor compatibility.
Some negative-assigned examples contain fragment text that is not explicitly negative on its own, so sentiment interpretation is constrained by limited excerpt context.
Only a subset of topic fragments was sampled, and the examples are stratified rather than representative.
